limitations: This resolves a pure capacity calculation only. Sixteen planned points do not establish sixteen distinct native states, adequate diversity or discovery of a control/effect table.

The chosen seed, complete action inventory, controller trajectory and point schedule must be fixed in a future collection protocol. This helper validates point shape/cost, not cryptographic provenance, plan membership, execution order or once-only consumption.

A collector must bind trials to current owned anchors, serialize admission with paid operations, retain failures and consume attempted trials even after truncation. The actual paid engine admission remains required.

Other E1/E2/E3/E4/C costs can postpone or prevent later points. The complete19720 example assumes no such additional experiments and no extra cold-start cost beyond the stated bootstrap; it is not a promised native cost.
Action0 versus NOOP and visually ineffective or truncated commands can remain unknown. No automatic null-effect or semantic label is produced.
Budget reports remain external diagnostic data and must not become learner observations. No protocol seal, native preflight, gate, training or parameter update is authorized by this source review.
